currentContext.expansion: FY 2025-26 was described by management as a year of capacity expansion and infrastructure development. The Bhatpore, Surat manufacturing facility was expanded and developed and has now progressed into full-fledged production operations, significantly strengthening the Company's overall manufacturing capacity and adding infrastructure to serve a growing customer base. Both plants - Ankleshwar and Bhatpore, Surat - ran at production of approximately 18 tons per month against installed capacity of approximately 22 tons per month during the year. A new freeze-drying machine with a daily processing capacity of approximately 450 kg was added at the Surat facility; management expects this equipment to increase production capability and contribute incremental revenue in the ensuing financial year. The Company also commissioned and operationalised a 350 kVA ground-mounted solar power plant at the Ankleshwar facility as part of its renewable-energy and carbon-footprint reduction commitment, and the Ankleshwar facility obtained Kosher certification during the year. On the inorganic side, HSDL Innovative Private Limited became a wholly-owned subsidiary on 25 March 2026 (100% equity acquired), extending the Group's presence in the freeze-dried and value-added food segment and providing, in management's words, additional revenue contribution and operational synergies. Going forward, the stated focus is on raising utilisation of the existing infrastructure, greater utilisation of the new Surat capacity, developing customised and value-added products and improving production yields. No rupee capex quantum is disclosed anywhere in the routed narrative.
